description: Reference for the Greptile CLI (`greptile`): reviewing a local branch before pushing, reading structured `--json` findings, interpreting exit codes, authenticating, and saving settings. Use when running any `greptile` command, when the user asks for a Greptile review of local changes, when wiring `greptile` into a hook, script, or CI job, or when interpreting Greptile review output. Covers `review`, `review status`, `review show`, `config`, `settings`, `login`, `whoami`, `skills`, and `fix`.
